turns.text: But of course, there are other simple ways to say thank you, too.
turns.zh: 不过当然，说谢谢还有其他简单的方式。

turns.text: You don't always need a big phrase,
turns.zh: 你不一定非要用一大串话，

turns.text: like just a simple thanks a lot or thank you so much.
turns.zh: 比如就简单说一句「多谢」或者「太感谢你了」。

turns.text: The so much or a lot just makes it feel bigger and more sincere.
turns.zh: 加上「太」或者「多谢」就会让感谢显得更重、更真诚。

turns.text: Or you can say that's so kind of you.
turns.zh: 或者你可以说「你真是太好了」。

turns.text: This shows you think the person is a good person for helping.
turns.zh: 这表示你觉得对方帮你是因为他是个好人。

turns.text: Now let's look at the other side of the coin.
turns.zh: 现在咱们来看看事情的另一面。

turns.text: What if someone asks you for a favor, but you can't do it?
turns.zh: 要是有人请你帮忙，但你又帮不了，该怎么办呢？
